title: Amazon Opens Trainium AI Chips to All PyTorch Developers to Rival Nvidia
summary:
The custom processors created for running neural networks are now available for use by the extensive community of engineers relying on the leading industry-standard AI library. Amazon has integrated its Trainium hardware with the PyTorch framework, allowing any developer to train and deploy models on its proprietary AWS silicon rather than relying on external hardware vendors.

The expanded access targets the current market dominance of Nvidia in the artificial intelligence sector. By removing barriers for those using the PyTorch library, Amazon intends to facilitate a broader migration of AI workloads into its own hardware ecosystem within the cloud.
